item.title: fix(sessions): reject rebound transcript turns (#119221)
item.summary: fix(sessions): reject rebound transcript turns (#119221) Route persisted session turns through the existing identity-checked writer while keeping memory-only provenance reads non-materializing. Rejected turns no longer create agent database state through provenance or empty cursor bookkeeping. Fixes #119220 Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger Co-authored-by: ruel225
